استغربوا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْرَبُوا (istaḡrabū) /is.taɣ.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
# اُسْتُغْرِبُوا (ustuḡribū) /us.tuɣ.ri.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
# اِسْتَغْرِبُوا (istaḡribū) /is.taɣ.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
